2121752850565148856.en_summary: Anthropic is a major winner of the Nvidia fallout. Its the frontier lab least locked into Nvidia (runs on Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium, and AMD as a fungible pool), one of the strongest advocates for export controls on China, and the only major US lab that refuses to release open weight models (&the notable holdout on Jensen’s open weights letter earlier this year). Its IPO remains heavily oversubscribed in the same week Nvidia shed ~$500B. Jensen was building for a multi-model world & Anthropic is not.
2121752850565148856.zh_summary: Anthropic是Nvidia餘波的主要贏家。它是最少鎖定Nvidia的前沿實驗室（在Google TPU、Amazon Trainium和AMD上作為可互換池運行），是對中國出口管制最強烈的倡導者之一，也是唯一拒絕發布開放權重模型的主要美國實驗室（以及今年早些時候對Jensen開放權重信的顯著持異議者）。其IPO在Nvidia市值蒸發約5000億美元的同一週仍嚴重超額認購。Jensen正在為多模型世界建設，而Anthropic不是。
